title: Norwegian Wood (This Bird Has Flown)

sections.name: Intro (hook over D)
sections.note: The hook melody uses the ♭7 (C on the B string, fret 1).

sections.name: Verse
sections.note: D throughout, then the phrase-end passing chords below. Length by ear.

sections.name: Verse phrase end
sections.bars: D | D/C# | D | C | G | D
sections.note: One chord per bar as the tab lays it out.

why: **Chord-melody** — a melody played inside a held chord — plus Mixolydian (♭7) and Dorian (minor i with major IV) side by side.
hard_change: **Hook melody notes over D** without losing the 3/4 strum.
theory: Verse is I with a melodic ♭7 (Mixolydian). Bridge i–IV (Dm–G, Dorian colour), then ii–V (Em–A) back to I.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: D → Dsus4 → D → C-note hook, then the bridge.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 125 bpm in 3).
